card.name: Digits in Bible verse references
card.fires_on: Digits inside chapter and verse numbers in Bible citations, especially a second digit after another digit. Also fires on the end of some proper names and ID numbers.

modes.label: Bible verse digits
modes.description: A digit that continues or ends a verse or chapter number in a scripture citation.

modes.label: Serial or sequence numbers
modes.description: A digit inside an identifier such as an OEIS sequence code.

modes.label: Ends of proper surnames
modes.description: The last piece of a person's name split into parts, such as Fillmore or Novak.

card.plain: It lights up on the last digits of Bible verse numbers, and sometimes on the ends of split-up names.
